name: morrel
description: Memory store for coding agents where every memory is gated by a passing Kane CLI flow.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @morrel/core run build && pnpm --filter @morrel/cli --filter @morrel/mcp run build && pnpm --filter @morrel/web run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @morrel/core run test && pnpm --filter @morrel/mcp run test
